activity.notes: Kristján Eldjárn took office as President of Iceland on 1 August 1968. He was reelected unopposed in 1972 and 1976 and completed his final four-year term on 31 July 1980, with Vigdís Finnbogadóttir succeeding on 1 August.

sources.title: Fylgiskjöl með skýrslu vinnuhóps um forsetakosningar — Alþingi
sources.citation_text: The Icelandic Parliament's election-history appendix states that Kristján Eldjárn was elected for the term 1 August 1968–31 July 1972 and was reelected unopposed in 1972 and 1976.

sources.title: Minning Kristján Eldjárns fyrrv. forseta Íslands — Alþingi
sources.citation_text: Alþingi records that Kristján Eldjárn assumed the presidency on 1 August 1968 and held it for twelve years until 1 August 1980.
